worksheets.toleranceRationale: Capacity scaling remains analytically traceable because only the compartment capacity term changes in the deterministic reference equation.

worksheets.toleranceRationale: The no-decay branch is deterministic and analytically traceable to the linear accumulation limit of the same finite-duration release equation.

worksheets.toleranceRationale: The governed temperature-correction branch remains a deterministic closed-form transformation of the same finite-duration first-order release equation.
